---
title: "JA-MENTOR Youth Survey Option Auditor & Validator"
format:
  html:
    theme: none
    minimal: true
    toc: false
    page-layout: custom
    css: src/app.css
---

```{=html}
<div class="app-header">
  <div class="header-inner">
    <div class="badge-tag">🔬 JA-MENTOR Cross-Country Harmonization</div>
    <h1 class="app-title">JA-MENTOR Youth Survey Option Auditor & Validator</h1>
    <p class="app-subtitle">
      Interactive quality assurance & harmonization engine for the <strong>JA-MENTOR youth mental health questionnaire</strong>.
    </p>
    <div class="purpose-box">
      <strong>💡 Harmonization Objective:</strong>
      In the JA-MENTOR project, surveys are implemented across multiple European countries in different languages. This auditor evaluates whether national survey implementations can be reliably mapped into a unified common data format.
      <br />
      <div class="privacy-badge">
        🔒 100% Client-Side Privacy: Spreadsheets are processed exclusively in your browser's local RAM. No data is sent over the network.
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="main-layout">

  <!-- Upload & Action Bar -->
  <div class="action-card">
    <div class="drop-zone" id="drop-zone">
      <div class="drop-zone-icon">📁</div>
      <div class="drop-zone-text">Drop your country survey export file here (<code>Content_Export_*.xlsx</code>)</div>
      <div class="drop-zone-hint">or click to browse local files (.xlsx, .xls)</div>
      <input type="file" id="file-input" accept=".xlsx, .xls" style="display: none;" />
    </div>
    <div class="action-buttons">
      <button type="button" id="btn-load-sample" class="btn btn-primary" onclick="window.loadBundledSample()">
        🚀 Load Sample Data
      </button>
      <button type="button" id="btn-export-issues" class="btn btn-export" onclick="window.exportAuditIssuesCSV()">
        📥 Export Audit Issues (CSV)
      </button>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- Initial Empty State -->
  <div id="empty-state-view" class="table-card empty-state">
    <div class="empty-state-icon">📊</div>
    <div class="empty-state-title">No Survey File Loaded</div>
    <p style="max-width: 500px; margin: 0 auto 1.5rem auto;">
      Upload your national survey data export spreadsheet, or click <strong>"Load Sample Data"</strong> to test the auditor with the bundled example dataset.
    </p>
    <button type="button" class="btn btn-primary" onclick="window.loadBundledSample()">
      🚀 Test with Bundled Sample Dataset
    </button>
  </div>

  <!-- Dashboard View (Shown after file load) -->
  <div id="dashboard-view" style="display: none;">

    <!-- Loaded file indicator -->
    <div style="margin-bottom: 1rem;">
      <span id="loaded-file-info" class="badge-tag" style="background: rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.1); color: var(--primary-700); border-color: rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.2); font-size: 0.85rem; display: none;"></span>
    </div>

    <!-- KPI Summary Cards -->
    <div class="kpi-grid">
      <div class="kpi-card kpi-all active" data-filter="all" id="kpi-card-all">
        <div class="kpi-title">Total Variables <span>📋</span></div>
        <div class="kpi-value" id="kpi-val-total">0</div>
        <div class="kpi-subtext">Columns in survey export</div>
      </div>
      <div class="kpi-card kpi-green" data-filter="fully_identified" id="kpi-card-green">
        <div class="kpi-title">Fully Identified <span>🟢</span></div>
        <div class="kpi-value" id="kpi-val-green" style="color: var(--status-green-text);">0</div>
        <div class="kpi-subtext">All canonical options defined</div>
      </div>
      <div class="kpi-card kpi-yellow" data-filter="incomplete" id="kpi-card-yellow">
        <div class="kpi-title">Incomplete / Inferred <span>🟡</span></div>
        <div class="kpi-value" id="kpi-val-yellow" style="color: var(--status-yellow-text);">0</div>
        <div class="kpi-subtext">Options inferred / partial list</div>
      </div>
      <div class="kpi-card kpi-red" data-filter="missing_options" id="kpi-card-red">
        <div class="kpi-title">Missing Options <span>🔴</span></div>
        <div class="kpi-value" id="kpi-val-red" style="color: var(--status-red-text);">0</div>
        <div class="kpi-subtext">No options in specification</div>
      </div>
      <div class="kpi-card kpi-gray" data-filter="open_ended" id="kpi-card-gray">
        <div class="kpi-title">Open-Ended <span>⚪</span></div>
        <div class="kpi-value" id="kpi-val-gray" style="color: var(--status-gray-text);">0</div>
        <div class="kpi-subtext">Continuous / Free text</div>
      </div>
      <div class="kpi-card kpi-red" data-filter="issues" id="kpi-card-issues">
        <div class="kpi-title">Flagged Issues <span>⚠️</span></div>
        <div class="kpi-value" id="kpi-val-issues" style="color: var(--status-red-text);">0</div>
        <div class="kpi-subtext">Sum of Incomplete (🟡) + Missing (🔴)</div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Status & Harmonization Explanation Guide -->
    <div class="status-guide-card">
      <div class="status-guide-header">
        <h2 class="status-guide-title">
          Understanding Audit Statuses & Harmonization Flags
        </h2>
      </div>
      <div class="status-guide-grid">
        <div class="guide-item guide-yellow">
          <span style="font-size: 1.25rem; line-height: 1;">🟡</span>
          <div>
            <strong>Incomplete / Inferred Options</strong>
            The canonical response options were not fully pre-enumerated in the master English specification, but rather inferred from observed sample responses or parallel scale patterns. <em>Harmonization Risk:</em> Unobserved answer branches (e.g., categories not selected by any respondent in the sample) risk being omitted from the canonical data model.
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="guide-item guide-red">
          <span style="font-size: 1.25rem; line-height: 1;">🔴</span>
          <div>
            <strong>Missing Options</strong>
            The variable is present in the national survey export, but has <strong>0 defined response options</strong> in the master specification (e.g. conditional branching follow-up questions). <em>Harmonization Risk:</em> Cannot be automatically harmonized until response categories and value codes are explicitly added to the master dictionary.
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="guide-item guide-issues">
          <span style="font-size: 1.25rem; line-height: 1;">⚠️</span>
          <div>
            <strong>Flagged Issues = Incomplete (🟡) + Missing Options (🔴)</strong>
            This metric represents the <strong>total sum of all problematic variables</strong> requiring review by survey programmers and field teams. These items need explicit option specification, translation verification, or scale completion before freezing data for cross-country joint analysis.
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="guide-item guide-green">
          <span style="font-size: 1.25rem; line-height: 1;">🟢</span>
          <div>
            <strong>Fully Identified</strong>
            All canonical response categories are fully defined in the master specification and match the observed survey values with confirmed numerical coding.
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="guide-item guide-gray">
          <span style="font-size: 1.25rem; line-height: 1;">⚪</span>
          <div>
            <strong>Open-Ended / Free Text</strong>
            Free-text fields (e.g. trauma descriptions) where discrete categorical options do not apply.
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="guide-item" style="grid-column: 1 / -1; background: #f8fafc; border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); color: var(--text-main);">
          <span style="font-size: 1.25rem; line-height: 1;">💡</span>
          <div>
            <strong>Skipped Questions vs. Explicit Refusal Options:</strong>
            <strong>Missing data</strong> occurs when a respondent <em>skips a question</em> entirely, leaving the cell blank/empty in the export. This is strictly distinct from respondents actively selecting coded special options such as <em>"Prefer not to answer"</em> (recode <code>[999]</code>), <em>"Don't know"</em> (recode <code>[998]</code>), or <em>"Not applicable"</em> (recode <code>[997]</code>). The Details panel displays both the valid vs. skipped breakdown and the exact distribution across all chosen options.
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Search & Filter Controls -->
    <div class="section-heading-block">
      <h2 class="section-title">Search & Filter Variables</h2>
      <p class="section-description">
        Filter the audit table by validation status using the buttons below, or search for specific variable names, question wording, or survey sections in real time.
      </p>
    </div>
    <div class="controls-bar">
      <div class="search-wrapper">
        <span class="search-icon">🔍</span>
        <input type="text" id="search-input" class="search-input" placeholder="Search by variable ID, question text, or section..." />
      </div>
      <div class="filter-pills">
        <button type="button" class="pill-btn active" data-filter="all">All</button>
        <button type="button" class="pill-btn" data-filter="fully_identified">🟢 Fully Identified</button>
        <button type="button" class="pill-btn" data-filter="incomplete">🟡 Incomplete</button>
        <button type="button" class="pill-btn" data-filter="missing_options">🔴 Missing</button>
        <button type="button" class="pill-btn" data-filter="open_ended">⚪ Open-Ended</button>
        <button type="button" class="pill-btn" data-filter="issues">⚠️ Issues Only</button>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Table View -->
    <div class="table-card">
      <div style="padding: 1rem 1.25rem; background: var(--bg-subtle); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color); display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem;">
        <div>
          <strong style="font-size: 0.95rem; display: block; color: var(--text-main); margin-bottom: 0.15rem;">Variable Audit & Harmonization Table</strong>
          <span style="font-size: 0.825rem; color: var(--text-muted);">
            💡 <strong>Row Inspection:</strong> Click the <strong>"Details"</strong> button on any row to compare the master specification against observed export responses, view numeric recode values (e.g. <code>[1]</code>, <code>[999]</code>), and review specific harmonization warnings.
          </span>
        </div>
        <span id="table-count-label" class="badge-tag" style="background: rgba(100, 116, 139, 0.1); color: var(--text-muted); border-color: var(--border-color); font-size: 0.775rem; margin: 0;">Showing 0 variables</span>
      </div>
      <div class="table-responsive">
        <table class="audit-table">
          <thead>
            <tr>
              <th>#</th>
              <th>Status</th>
              <th>Variable</th>
              <th>Question Header / Section</th>
              <th>Scale & Type</th>
              <th>Options Coverage</th>
              <th style="text-align: right;">Action</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody id="audit-table-body">
            <!-- Rows rendered dynamically by src/app.js -->
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
    </div>

  </div>

</div>

<!-- Embedded Libraries and Application Modules -->
<script src="src/xlsx.full.min.js"></script>
<script src="src/master_dictionary_bundle.js"></script>
<script src="src/survey_validator.js"></script>
<script src="src/sample_data.js"></script>
<script src="src/app.js"></script>
```
